planner_json.title: Refuse each keyed harness by name when its own key is absent

write_prohibited: test/harness/controls/index.mjs - E3 is its one writer
test/harness/smoke/observations.mjs - E2 and E3 own it; `attachMissingKey` is reused unchanged
The existing Keyless control step - sprint-01 flows pin it
Any file not listed in WRITE-ALLOWED

seed/real-workflow-step.description: The real harness-eval.yml, whose new step body is executed in a sandbox with every credential removed, once per keyed harness
records: 5 keyed harnesses: claude-code, codex, grok, opencode, pi

specification.objective: Each keyed harness refuses by name with zero model requests when its own key is absent, and each control row reports the leg furthest from that control's own expect.
specification.success_state: A Per-harness keyless control step runs on the codex, grok, opencode and pi pinned legs. The `missing-key` row carries `per_harness` with 5 keys and matches only when all 5 refuse. A failure on any leg survives either file walk order. `test/harness/ENVIRONMENT.md` names the new step.

requirements.description: GIVEN the real `harness-eval.yml` step body with every credential removed WHEN it executes for each of codex, grok, opencode and pi, then once with that harness's binding set to a placeholder THEN 4 rows read `could-not-run` `missing-api-key` with `model_requests` 0 and `child_ran` false, and the placeholder run exits non-zero with `the keyless control is invalid`
requirements.verification_service: real workflow file, real guard, real child process marker
requirements.positive_example: For each of codex, grok, opencode and pi the body writes a row reading could-not-run, missing-api-key, 0 model requests, child_ran false, and attaches it to that cell record.
requirements.red: On base no Per-harness keyless control step exists in harness-eval.yml, so the test finds no body to run.

scenario.verification_service: real workflow file, real guard, real child process marker

would_fail_if: the step binds a key, so absence proves nothing
the guard is removed and the marker child starts
the row is a hardcoded constant rather than the guard's own reason

build_proof.range: anything that proves each keyed harness's binding is what the guard looks for and that it refuses without it
examples: the guard reading that harness's pin

steps: extract the step body from the real workflow file
execute it for each of codex, grok, opencode, pi with every credential removed
execute it once with that harness's binding set to a placeholder

must_observe: 4 rows reading `could-not-run` and `missing-api-key` with `model_requests` 0 and `child_ran` false
the placeholder run exits non-zero with `the keyless control is invalid`

requirements.description: GIVEN cell files with `hidden-image-judge` failing on the first leg walked, `exit0-denied-read` reading `fail denied_tool_call` on claude-code and could-not-run `stream-mapping-fact-not-applicable` on pi WHEN the producer step body runs over them, then with the file names reversed, then with codex's `exit0-denied-read` reading pass, then with grok's missing-key row reading pass THEN both walks keep `hidden-image-judge` at `fail` and `exit0-denied-read` at `fail` with `matched` true, `missing-key` carries 5 `per_harness` keys, codex's pass reads `matched` false on that row, and grok's pass reads `matched` false on `missing-key`
requirements.verification_service: real controls module and the real producer step body over real cell files on disk
requirements.positive_example: Five cell files with matching missing-key rows give a per_harness map of 5 and matched true. With claude-code reading fail denied_tool_call and pi reading could-not-run stream-mapping-fact-not-applicable, exit0-denied-read reads fail denied_tool_call in either walk order. A fail on any leg's hidden-image-judge survives in either order.
requirements.red: On base the producer's merge overwrites by file order, so a later pass replaces an earlier hidden-image-judge fail, and a pi leg walked last replaces exit0-denied-read, and this test fails.

scenario.verification_service: real controls module and the real producer step body over real cell files on disk

would_fail_if: the merge stays last-write-wins, so a failing observation is removed
the merge ranks every could-not-run as worst, so a leg with no gate sinks exit0-denied-read
per_harness is omitted and one row speaks for five harnesses

build_proof.range: anything that proves each row reports the leg furthest from its own expect, and that the missing-key row names every keyed harness

steps: write cell files for the keyed harnesses, with hidden-image-judge failing on the first in walk order, exit0-denied-read reading fail denied_tool_call on claude-code, and could-not-run stream-mapping-fact-not-applicable on pi
run the producer step body over them, then again with the file names reversed
run it again with codex's exit0-denied-read reading pass, then with grok's missing-key row reading pass

must_observe: `hidden-image-judge` reads `fail` in controls.json on both walks
`exit0-denied-read` reads `fail` `denied_tool_call` with `matched` true on both walks
`missing-key` carries `per_harness` with 5 keys on the first run
codex's pass makes `exit0-denied-read` read `pass` with `matched` false, and grok's pass makes `missing-key` read `matched` false
must_not_observe: a controls array with other than 4 rows
`hidden-image-judge` reading pass on the first run
`exit0-denied-read` reading `stream-mapping-fact-not-applicable` while another leg observed it
